title: Receive
subtitle: Share the right address for where the sender is sending from.
spending_address: SPENDING ADDRESS (G…) — USE FOR MOST SENDERS
spending_address_desc: Use this address to receive XLM from exchanges, classic wallets, and most apps. Works with Coinbase, Lobstr, and any Stellar wallet.
contract_address: CONTRACT ADDRESS (C…) — SOROBAN / VEIL WALLETS ONLY
contract_address_desc: Use this address only when sending from another Veil wallet or a Soroban-compatible app. Classic wallets cannot send to C… addresses.
spending_address_notice: Your spending address (G…) will appear here after you tap Fund wallet on the dashboard.
